name: Filters
description: A collection of Filter objects that represents all the filters in an autofiltered range.
example:
Dim f As Filter
Dim w As Worksheet
Const ns As String = "Not set"

Set w = Worksheets("Crew")
Set w2 = Worksheets("FilterData")
rw = 1
For Each f In w.AutoFilter.Filters
 If f.On Then
 c1 = Right(f.Criteria1, Len(f.Criteria1) - 1)
 If f.Operator Then
 op = f.Operator
 c2 = Right(f.Criteria2, Len(f.Criteria2) - 1)
 Else
 op = ns
 c2 = ns
 End If
 Else
 c1 = ns
 op = ns
 c2 = ns
 End If
 w2.Cells(rw, 1) = c1
 w2.Cells(rw, 2) = op
 w2.Cells(rw, 3) = c2
 rw = rw + 1
Next

properties.name: Application
